subject.title: feat(ios): improve onboarding gateway connection flow

question: Should OpenClaw sponsor this secure-only Tailscale onboarding path, and should it be rebased onto the current iOS onboarding refresh before merge?
rationale: The branch changes first-run product UX and raw 100.x setup policy while current main already has an overlapping onboarding refresh, so automation should not choose the permanent UX/security direction.

options.title: Rebase and narrow secure Tailscale onboarding
options.body: Port only the Tailscale/MagicDNS/raw-IP blocking and auth-copy improvements onto the current onboarding surface, then reprove the fresh-install and upgrade behavior.

options.title: Close as covered by current onboarding
options.body: If maintainers do not want a first-class Tailscale path now, close this PR and keep the current onboarding refresh as the canonical surface.

options.title: Accept the policy change after owner review
options.body: Keep the secure-only raw-IP behavior but require explicit owner approval and compatibility notes before resolving the conflicts.

recommendation.title: Rebase and narrow secure Tailscale onboarding
recommendation.body: Port only the Tailscale/MagicDNS/raw-IP blocking and auth-copy improvements onto the current onboarding surface, then reprove the fresh-install and upgrade behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main iOS/release history makes this the best available owner for deciding whether the security/compatibility policy should ship.
